880-5671-8345.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
880-5671-8345.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed.
When the land enters the battlefield, The Necrobloom triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

141-728-6929.description:
Cast Behold the Sinister Six! by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Behold the Sinister Six!.
Holding priority, activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Naru Meha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Behold the Sinister Six!
Resolve the Behold the Sinister Six! copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to the creature with changeling

3967-4640-8032--201.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature with changeling.
When that creature dies, Oathkeeper triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When that creature enters, Swordsman triggers, allowing you to attach Oathkeeper to that creature.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

2021-2060-3334-5902.description:
Activate Simic Ascendancy by paying {1}{G}{U}, putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Simic Ascendancy triggers, putting growth counters on it.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by removing three +1/+1 counters from it, adding {1}{G}{U}.
Repeat.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Simic Ascendancy triggers, causing you to win the game.

851-5658-6245-7824.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
851-5658-6245-7824.description:
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 4 for each remaining trigger.
851-5658-6245-7824.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

215-4359-6478.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-4359-6478.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2104-4064-7722.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Abuelo.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Temporal Manipulation from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

413-5086-6972.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Triskelavus.
When Triskelavus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
When Triskelavus enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

372-2974-7174.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of nonland permanents exiled by Abdel Adrian that enter the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least the mana cost of Personify.
372-2974-7174.description:
Cast Personify by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and re-enters the battlefield, causing all cards exiled with it to be returned to the battlefield. Abdel Adrian and Repository Skaab's exploit ability trigger.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, exploiting another creature and triggering its second ability.
Holding priority, activate any number of permanents by tapping them, adding at least the cost of Personify.
Resolve the Repository Skaab trigger, returning Personify from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling the mana producing permanent(s) and Repository Skaab and creating that many 1/1 Soldier creature tokens.
Repeat.

628-5256-7198.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability
Repeat.

4311-4871-5147-5220.notablePrerequisites: You control a nontoken creature that can be cast using one colored mana.
4311-4871-5147-5220.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing the nontoken creature.
When the creature dies, Mortuary and Pitiless Plunderer trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Pitiless Plunderer trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Cast the creature from the top of your library by paying its mana cost
Repeat.

628-2511-7191.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Bristlebane Battler.
When Bristlebane Battler dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability
Repeat.

1636-2034-6786-7028-7148.description:
Activate Urza by paying {1}, causing you to loot. The discarded card will be put on top of your library instead of into your graveyard due to Library of Leng.
Wan Shi Tong's second ability triggers, creating two 1/1 Spirit creature tokens.
When the Spirits enter, Intruder Alarm triggers twice, untapping all creatures.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Spirit, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

2191-6556-7070.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with power 4 or greater.
2191-6556-7070.description:
Cast Martyrdom by paying {1}{W}{W}, targeting Monk Gyatso.
Activate Monk Gyatso by paying {0}, targeting another nontoken creature you control.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
Monk Gyatso's ability from step 4 fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to Temur Battlecrier.
Repeat from step 2.

141-997-1269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-997-1269.description:
Cast Exhume by paying its mana cost
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Exhume.
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Exhume
Resolve the Exhume copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

3532-5060-5078-5402.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-5060-5078-5402.notablePrerequisites: There is an artifact card exiled with Cemetery Prowler.
3532-5060-5078-5402.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Captain Storm triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Captain Storm.
Repeat.

997-2173-3558-5220.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Crookshank Kobolds
When Crookshank Kobolds dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Crookshank Kobolds from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Cast Crookshank Kobolds from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

104-589-2498.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-589-2498.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fathom Mage.
Fathom Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Sheoldred triggers, causing you to gain 3 life.
Repeat from step 2.

1434-2232-2537-4089.description:
Cast Ghalta by paying {5}{G}{G}{G}.
When Ghalta enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Glasspool Mimic to your hand if its on the battlefield, or returning nothing to your hand otherwise.
Resolve the Ghalta trigger, putting Glasspool Mimic onto the battlefield as a copy of Ghalta from your hand.
When Glasspool Mimic enters the battlefield, it and Cloudstone Curio trigger.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, returning Ghalta to your hand from the battlefield.
Resolve the Glasspool Mimic trigger, putting Ghalta onto the battlefield from your hand.
Repeat from step 2.

147-3263-4483.notablePrerequisites: You've cast your commander from the command zone at least once this game.
147-3263-4483.description:
Cast Echo Storm by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Echo Storm triggers, creating a copy of itself, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Echo Storm, creating a token copy of Dualcaster Mage.
When the Dualcaster Mage token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a copy of Echo Storm, targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Repeat from step 3.

444-2498.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
444-2498.description:
Draw a card.
Sheoldred's first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Drogskol Reaver triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

1524-2724-4006.notablePrerequisites: Ilharg does not have summoning sickness.
1524-2724-4006.description:
Attack with Ilharg.
Ilharg's attack trigger triggers, putting Wormfang Manta onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
At the beginning of your end step, Wormfang Manta is returned to your hand.
This triggers its LTB, granting you an extra turn after this one.
Repeat for infinite turns.
